events.description: Multiple players from opposing teams engage in a group physical altercation on the ice, involving grappling, pushing, and shoving; referees intervene to separate them.

A chaotic cluster of players from both teams converges violently near the boards, with multiple simultaneous physical engagements and loss of positional control, indicating collective violent unrest beyond a simple two-person fight.
Two men in suits (coaches or staff) engage in a physical altercation behind the glass near the bench, involving shoving and grabbing; one man in a blue jacket intervenes physically.

A man in a dark suit repeatedly pushes and strikes a man in a blue jacket who appears to be attempting to de-escalate or separate; the blue-jacketed individual is not actively resisting and is being struck while leaning against the glass.

Two men in suits (coaches/staff) engage in a physical altercation behind the glass near the bench, with one man in a dark suit shoving and then punching the other man in a black suit; the exchange includes multiple strikes and grappling.

Players from both teams (white and blue jerseys) engage in a multi-person scuffle on the ice near the bench area, involving pushing, grabbing, and helmet-to-helmet contact; referees intervene to separate them.

A physical altercation erupts between players and staff across the glass barrier near the bench area; individuals in suits and jerseys are seen grabbing, pushing, and striking each other through and over the plexiglass.

The initial fight escalates into a larger group confrontation involving multiple players from both teams, referees, and bench personnel; chaotic clustering, shoving, and attempts to separate occur across the bench area with sustained intensity.
Multiple players from opposing teams engage in a sustained physical altercation at center ice, involving shoving, grappling, and punches; referees intervene to separate them.
Multiple players from opposing teams engage in a multi-person on-ice fight near the boards, involving punching, grappling, and helmet removal; referees intervene to separate them.

Escalation of on-ice fighting leads to bench-clearing involvement: players from both teams leave the benches and converge on the altercation, creating a large chaotic group clash with multiple simultaneous physical engagements and referee attempts to restore order.
